messages:
Tess: FYI ran into a surprising case where jsonmode + fn_call returns a double-encoded string on retries when the temp token expired. node SDK helper ends up parsing into an array string, py stays strict and errors.
Rohit: can you paste the exact raw response you saw?
Tess: raw body on first 401 was: `"[{\"cmd\":\"upsert\",\"id\":\"x\"}]"` after retry it got parsed by node into `[{"cmd":"upsert","id":"x"}]` but python raised JSONDecodeError because it expected object.
Gabrielle: that pattern smells like our retry wrapper re-stringifying the body for logging and then sending the quoted string on the retry. I hit a similar class last quarter.
Rohit: yep. in node we have `helpers/parseToolPayload.js` that tolerates stringified arrays and coercion to keep older clients working. python intentionally doesn't coerce.
Tess: repro steps:
```
# expire temp token then run
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPIRED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonmode":true,"fn_call":true,"prompt":"run"}'
```
On expired token path the server sends 401 then client retries; middleware logged request/response and did `JSON.stringify(body)` which introduced extra quotes.
Gabrielle: proposed short fixes: 1) patch retry wrapper to forward raw bytes without JSON.stringify, 2) remove client-side permissive coercion in node by default (make it opt-in), 3) add an interop parity test in sample-app CI that asserts identical parsed shapes between node+py.
Rohit: agree. additionally, add a tiny e2e that simulates token expiry so we catch retry-path double-encoding in CI.
Tess: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/512 with logs and minimal repro. will include stack trace pointing to `http/retry-middleware.js:87`.
ops-bot: infra ticket created #infra-801 for retry-middleware fix; ETA 2h.
SDK-release-bot: will schedule a patch release after merge and run the parity matrix.
Gabrielle: i'll write the docs blurb: "When using jsonmode+fn_call, expired-token retries may surface as double-encoded payloads; enable sdk.config.jsonMode.strict to fail fast until patch lands."
Tess: thanks  that mitigation is helpful for onboarding tests. i'll update our sample-app to set strict=true and add a note in the README until SDK patch is out.
Rohit: i'll take the patch PR for retry wrapper and the node helper change. moving to review.
Tess: thanks all, leaving the CI pin in place and will remove after the release.
